items.rationale: Covered as a fractured fitting due to internal frost under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9; reference Case 25 shows t between 51 and 54 for this exact line under the same policy and peril.
Covered as a necessary connection element renewed with the fractured fitting (7.1.9); reference Case 25 shows t between 26 and 28 for this line.
Labour for covered repair is indemnified (7.1.7(f)); Case 25 shows t >= 279 for 3 hours under the same policy and peril.
Consumables actually used in covered repair are indemnified (7.1.7(e)); Case 25 shows t below 8, possibly 0, so lowest proven charge was too high.
Vehicle costs for attendance on covered repair are indemnified (7.1.11); Case 25 shows t between 38 and 44.
Equipment used for leak location is covered (2.4.6, 7.1.7); Case 25 shows t below 28, possibly 0, so lowest proven charge was too high.
Return visits are not indemnified unless agreed in advance (7.1.11); reference Case 25 and others show t = 0 for return visits.

items.description: Facade frost damage - remove loose and spalled plaster
items.rationale: Covered as direct repair of frost-damaged external surface under 2.6.2 (peril is endorsed); reference Case 25 and 7 show this is covered when peril is agreed.
Covered as part of making good the damaged area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(c)); reference Case 25 and 7 show this is covered when peril is agreed.
Covered as part of reinstating the substrate beneath the damaged area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(c)); reference Case 25 and 7.
Priming is part of the finish system required to reinstate the damaged area (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)); reference Case 25 and 7.
Drying needed before repair of the affected part is covered (2.6.2, 7.1.7(c)); reference Case 25 and 7.
Painting the repaired area is covered (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)); only the damaged elevation, not undamaged areas (7.1.5, 2.6.3(a)); reference Case 25 and 7.
Labour for covered repair is indemnified (7.1.7(f)); reference Case 25 and 7, but painter hours for undamaged areas are not covered.
Access provision for covered work is indemnified (2.6.2, 7.1.8); only for the damaged elevation, not for undamaged areas.

items.description: Repaint of undamaged rear elevation (no frost loss there)
items.rationale: Work on undamaged areas is excluded (2.6.3(a), 7.1.5); reference Case 25 and 7 show t = 0 for undamaged elevations.
Disposal of material from covered repair is indemnified (2.6.2, 5.2.1, 7.1.11); reference Case 25 and 7.
Charges levied in addition to the work for administration/processing are excluded (3.6(b), 7.1.12); reference Case 25 and others.
Provisioning/catering for own personnel is excluded (3.6(a), 7.1.12); reference Case 25 and others.
